# Fares Khanchouch

> Forward Deployed Engineer based in Tunis, Tunisia, working on integrations and LLM agent tooling for enterprise systems.

- Integration Consultant at Axe Finance (Dec 2025 – present): credit-platform delivery for banks in Qatar and Saudi Arabia, core-banking integration over REST (C#), and Python MCP servers with 50 typed tools and 11 Claude skills.
- Previously a freelance automation engineer (n8n, Make, LLM pipelines) and cloud/DevOps intern.
- Engineering degree in Computer Science, ISTY, Université Paris-Saclay (2021 – 2024).
- Languages: Arabic (native), French, English.
